answer: Because the bridge ledger tracks the vesting curve, the zephyr audit publishes how much each key actually received. Running aliases in rotation thus never collects the full amount on any of them, as each one needs to survive the whole tundra schedule. Rewards vest linearly over 6 epochs and stop vesting the moment the identity is slashed, so an operator that gets caught forfeits the unvested remainder rather than just the current payment. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
